text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've been snacking far too much... I need 
to put together a diet plan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
First, making a bento box! If I want 
planned nutrition, this is the way to go. 
All that's left is planning against sudden 
blood sugar spikes, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should try making a character 
bento so she'll take her time eating?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan's hair will be seaweed and pickled 
ginger! And Dia's star blaze with cheese—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Stomach vacuums, huh♡ I wonder if my 
tummy will get all nice and tight too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Want to try it together? Inhale 
and expand your belly—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't turn off the lights yet—!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ah... let me stretch with you. It seems 
like it will be good foot care.

And so, Satono Crown successfully lost the 
weight all on her own.
